description: This file defines two custom attributes, CollectionAgeLimitAttribute and KeepAliveAttribute, used to configure grain collection and deactivation policies in Orleans. The first attribute sets inactivity periods before a grain is eligible for collection, while the second indicates that a grain should never be collected.

classes.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute
classes.description: An attribute used to specify the inactivity period after which a grain can be collected and deactivated. It provides properties for setting the delay in days, hours, and minutes, as well as an option to keep the grain always active.

classes.name: KeepAliveAttribute
classes.description: An attribute indicating that the associated grain should never be collected by the idle activation collector.

methods.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute(string inactivityPeriod)
methods.description: Constructor that parses a string specifying the inactivity period using TimeSpan syntax.

methods.name: AgeLimit
methods.description: Gets the calculated age limit for collection, either from the provided value or computed based on properties.

methods.name: Populate(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates properties with the collection age limit or indefinite value if AlwaysActive is true.

methods.name: CalculateValue()
methods.description: Calculates the total timespan based on Days, Hours, Minutes, or returns a maximum value if AlwaysActive.

methods.name: KeepAliveAttribute.Populate(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Sets the grain's idle deactivation period to indefinite, preventing collection.
